title: View of Hoi An
provenance: Acquired by the Singaporean collector, Lady Xanthe Lowry, in 1955; later sold to her niece, Ms. Elara Kaur Singh, in 1979; and eventually bequeathed to the estate of Mrs. Kaveri Nair, who exhibited it at the inaugural 'Art of Southeast Asia' exhibition at her gallery in 1994.
